description:
Role: .Net Front End Developer
 Duration: 12 months+
 Location: Columbus, OH
 Pay Rate: Open 
 

 This role will be primarily focused on implementing a company learning platform. This platform is an internally hosted vendor solution built on SQL Server 2008. 
 

 Responsibilities: 
 - Primary duty involves design work, specifically designing a tailored solution in order to meet a specific client request. 
 - Troubleshoots problems that involve trade-offs between cost containment and or timeliness of service. 
 - Articulates the business value and impact of technical and non-technical information and understands when to escalate issues. 
 - Provides effective production support including accurate problem identification, ticket documentation and customer/vendor dialogue. 
 - Delivers project and process documentation for small-to medium-scale projects. 
 

 A strong technology background to understand change requests and to recommend alternate solutions is needed to be successful in this role. 
 

 TOP Skills used in this role: 
 1. Web Server 
 2. MS IIS 
 3. .Net Development 
 4. SQL Server 
 

 Ideal Additional Experience: 
 1-2 years of Core Java 
 1-2 years of J2EE
 



 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
